prompt: Parse a date written in any of three formats by trying the patterns in order and catching DateTimeParseException until one works, reporting null and "unknown" when none do.
explanation: DateTimeFormatter reports a mismatch by throwing DateTimeParseException, so a fallback chain is simply a loop where each failed attempt is caught and the next pattern is tried. Pinning Locale.US matters most for "d MMM yyyy": the month abbreviation Jul is English, and on a machine with a different default locale the same pattern would reject it. Guarding for null or blank text up front keeps the loop from having to think about it, and returning null rather than throwing lets the caller decide how bad an unparseable date really is.
hints: Keep the three pattern strings in a String[] and loop over them so both methods share the same order.
Inside the loop, put LocalDate.parse(cleaned, DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(pattern, Locale.US)) in a try and catch DateTimeParseException with an empty body so the loop continues.
Returning from inside the try is what stops the search; falling out of the loop means nothing matched, so return null (or "unknown").
